$comment: Updates this repo has decided not to take yet. Read by scripts/check-dependency-updates.ts,
which fails on any compatible update — patch, minor, or prerelease-to-stable — that a pin has
not taken. An entry here downgrades that failure to a warning until its date; it never hides it.
`until` is exclusive: a deferral dated 2026-09-01 stops applying on 2026-09-01. Give a reason a
reader in three months can act on — what breaks, and what has to happen first.
`manifest` scopes an entry to one manifest; omit it and the entry speaks for every pin of that
name, which is wrong whenever the same package is pinned twice for different reasons.
`acceptedVulnerabilities` is the other half: a vulnerability this repo ships with, because the
install delay in bunfig.toml is never punctured — not even to reach a fix. A release published
days ago is how a compromised package arrives, so the delay outranks a known CVE, and when the
only fix is too young the vulnerability is carried instead. Each entry pairs one advisory with
one lockfile, matching an `sca.exclusions` entry in .fluidattacks/sca.yaml, which is where the
scanner is told to stop counting it. The reason and the expiry live here because that config
has nowhere to put them. An exclusion with no entry fails, an expired entry fails, and so does
an entry whose exclusion is gone.
CVE-2026-93687 and its scanner exclusion were removed on 2026-10-24 after upstream withdrew

deferredUpdates.name: jsdom
deferredUpdates.reason: jsdom 30.1.3 still breaks the Vitest 5.0.5 jsdom worker environment: its Window addEventListener rejects Vitest's Window proxy as an invalid EventTarget. Reproduced on 2026-10-24 UTC with the pinned Bun runtime and the normal web unit command: 197 tests passed but six jsdom workers failed before executing, exiting with status 1. Keep 30.0.1 until the integration is fixed; rerun the normal web unit and browser checks before updating. Trial evidence: /tmp/fidy-dep-web-unit.log.

deferredUpdates.name: typescript
deferredUpdates.reason: AstroCheck from @astrojs/language-server 2.17.2 rejects TypeScript 7.0.2 before checking any files because findConfigFile and sys are absent. Reproduced with the installed workspace compiler on 2026-10-16 UTC; the isolated TypeScript 6.0.3 checker remains operational. TypeScript 7.0 intentionally ships no programmatic API (https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-7-0/); revisit when Astro supports its replacement API, then rerun the site checker and repository typecheck before updating.

deferredUpdates.name: typescript
deferredUpdates.reason: With TypeScript 7.0.2, dependency-cruiser silently cruises zero modules and the repo's tripwire exits because no architecture rules ran. Revisit after TypeScript 7.1 ships the replacement compiler API and dependency-cruiser adopts it.

deferredUpdates.name: typescript
deferredUpdates.reason: With TypeScript 7.0.2, Stryker's tsconfig rewrite crashes because parseConfigFileTextToJson is missing. Revisit after TypeScript 7.1 ships the replacement compiler API and Stryker adopts it.

deferredUpdates.name: @effect/tsgo
deferredUpdates.reason: 0.53.3 introduces 3,417 unstableApiUsage warnings for required Effect v4 HTTP, MCP, runtime and test APIs; the normal warning-failing project-reference build exits with status 2 and no TypeScript errors. Reproduced by normal installation and bun run typecheck with the pinned Bun runtime on 2026-10-24 UTC. Retain verified 0.46.1 without suppressing compiler diagnostics. Revisit upstream default severity and supported stable replacements before updating, then rerun the normal installer, typecheck and unit verification. Trial evidence: /tmp/fidy-dep-tsgo-trial.log.

deferredUpdates.name: @effect/vitest
deferredUpdates.reason: Some Effect 4.0.6 satellite packages crossed seven days on 2026-10-29 around 03:26 UTC, but the coordinated family cannot yet update: effect 4.0.6 was published 2026-10-22T17:47:13.255Z, @effect/platform-bun 4.0.6 at 18:29:03.133Z, and @effect/platform-node 4.0.6 at 18:30:12.643Z. Registry timestamps were checked on 2026-10-29 UTC. scripts/check-effect-family.ts requires one shared version; upgrading just this satellite would violate that invariant, while upgrading core now would violate the unchanged seven-day minimumReleaseAge. Retain the complete 4.0.5 family until 2026-10-29T18:30:12.643Z, then update all direct and override family pins together, update selected-source metadata, reinstall normally and rerun family/source/static, unit and browser checks. This defers a compatible update only; existing SCA exclusions and accepted vulnerabilities are unchanged. Primary evidence: https://registry.npmjs.org/effect and https://registry.npmjs.org/@effect/platform-node.

acceptedVulnerabilities.reason: The User explicitly selected retaining vulnerable versions with temporary acceptance on 2026-10-24 UTC for PR #1529, and clarified acceptance only until corrected versions reach seven days. body-parser 2.3.0 remains vulnerable: a crafted compressed request with trailing bytes can trigger an uncaught decoder error and process crash; application reachability is not asserted. Fixed 2.4.0 becomes eligible under the unchanged seven-day minimumReleaseAge at 2026-10-29T11:39:38.614Z; this acceptance expires at that exact instant. This is accepted installed risk, not remediation. Keep request bounds and all other checks active. Upgrade once eligible, rerun SCA and affected verification, then remove this record and its exact matching scanner exclusion. Upstream: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828

The User explicitly accepted this scoped installed risk on 2026-10-28 UTC for PR #1581 until 2026-11-04 UTC. deepmerge 4.3.1 is inherited through shadcn and @shadcn/registry tooling; malicious merge inputs can poison the returned object prototype. Application reachability is not asserted. npm has no patched release as of acceptance. This is risk acceptance, not remediation. Keep the seven-day minimumReleaseAge and all other checks active. Before expiry, replace the dependency or upgrade to an eligible corrected release, rerun SCA and affected verification, and remove this record and its exact matching scanner exclusion. Upstream: https://github.com/TehShrike/deepmerge/issues/273
